confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on two web searches. One was the RBA exchange rate. The other was crowdsourced MyLifeElsewhere averages for Tromso beer, cappuccino and inexpensive meals, and those pages disagree somewhat. I did not search for mid-range meal, cocktail or wine prices. The mid-range meal is an estimate scaled from the inexpensive meal. Cocktail and wine are set relative to the beer price, at about 1.5x and 1.3x. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from general knowledge, not live listings. Tromso summer prices, especially for July, can be much higher than average. The RBA rate of 0.6677 is from the 19 November 2026 column of the exchange rates table. It may be a same-day reading rather than a confirmed 4pm rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other high-cost Norwegian cities such as Oslo, Bergen and Tromso's northern tourism peers. Tromso is adjusted upward for its peak-season tourism demand and limited accommodation supply.
